description: A secret-free MCP registry for reproducing your toolset on a new machine. Secret VALUES are never stored here — only ${VAR} placeholders, which provision-toolset.sh substitutes from config/.env (gitignored). Copy this file to config/mcp-manifest.json and edit it to match the servers you actually use.

servers.name: memory
servers.note: A knowledge graph the agent can write to and read back. No secrets.

servers.name: github
servers.note: Issues, pull requests, code search. Needs a token with the scopes you intend to use. The VALUE lives in config/.env, never here.

servers.name: an-oauth-connector
servers.note: Connectors that authenticate interactively cannot be provisioned from a manifest. They are listed so the catalogue is complete, and skipped during provisioning.

servers.name: a-python-server
servers.linux_setup: uv venv ~/.local/venvs/example --python 3.12 && uv pip install --python ~/.local/venvs/example/bin/python some-mcp-server
servers.note: Not portable out of the box: the interpreter path differs per machine. `linux_setup` documents how to prepare it; provisioning reports it instead of pretending it worked.
